Amphion (son of Iasus): king of the Minyans of Orchomenus in Greek myth
Corybas: Greek hero, son of Iasion and Cybele
Corybas: héroe de la mitología griega, hijo de Iasión y Cibeles
Iasion: hero of Greek mythology, mythical founder of the Samothrace mysteries
Iaso: Greek goddess of recovery from illness
Iasus: king of Orchomenus, father of Amphion
